company.shortDescription: Netmaker is a modern virtual platform providing networking solution that runs on wireguard.
company.description: Netmaker is an open-source platform with a modern virtual networking solution on wireguards.

productsAndServices.description: A virtual networking solution that allows devices to connect directly to each other, forming a decentralized network without a central server.
productsAndServices.name: Netmaker Mesh VPN

productsAndServices.description: A software agent that configures WireGuard and routing rules on devices to establish secure connections within the mesh network.
productsAndServices.name: Netclient

productsAndServices.description: Dedicated routing nodes for VPN traffic, enabling relay, failover, remote access, and internet traffic routing without deploying additional devices.
productsAndServices.name: Managed Endpoints

productsAndServices.description: A feature that simplifies traditional VPN setups by creating traffic forwarders using relays and providing direct connections between devices.
productsAndServices.name: Internet Gateway

productsAndServices.description: A solution for integrating IoT devices into a secure, WireGuard-based VPN, supporting devices like ESP32 for private connections over public networks.
productsAndServices.name: IoT Gateway

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
